name: Statement Basis 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of balances on which the statement is prepared.

CONT.name: Contractual
CONT.definition: The statement is based on contractual settlement date irrespective of settled data positions.

SETT.name: Settled
SETT.definition: The statement is based on settled date positions to the knowledge of the sender at the time of the statement preparation.

TRAD.name: Traded
TRAD.definition: The statement is based on trade date positions.
